Here’s the honest take on “Compare Notion pages vs a real portfolio host” — written for people who want a link that works harder than a PDF.

When everyone lists the same tools and clubs, the differentiator becomes how cleanly you present proof.

This guide is for first-time portfolio builders who want a site that feels intentional — not another generic template dump.

The real problem

Smart portfolios feel calm: one idea per section, outcomes before tools, and a next step that doesn’t beg.

Do this next

  1. Open your site on a phone and fix anything that feels cramped or slow
  2. Rewrite your top project in problem → action → result
  3. Add your live URL to the next application you send today

Tools vs presentation

Free builders are fine for drafts. When the link goes on a CV, presentation quality becomes part of your professional signal — templates exist so you skip reinventing layout.

How a website helps you stand out

The fastest way to look unique is to publish something true — not to wait for a perfect custom build.

On BEXO, that path is simple: discover on mybexo.com, create on dash.mybexo.com, share on yourname.atbexo.com. Premium templates and a Hire Me page give you agency-grade presentation without becoming a full-time webmaster.

Field checklist

  • Claim your handle today
  • Add three real projects (or two + one strong case study)
  • Publish, then improve weekly

Try this today

Open your draft (or start one), apply one change from the list above, and publish. Momentum compounds faster than waiting for “ready.”
